verdict.rationale: Clerky is a SaaS platform that holds sensitive legal and company data, and it ships an MCP server for AI assistants, so a data-use and AI-training privacy posture is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy. The MCP server and team-scoped access controls are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
